known_information: Fixed exogenous scenario clocks known to agents, current simulated queues/onboard states and past residual seats; not a validated real-time forecast. V8 clocks are inferred, not official published timetables.
unverified_parameters: All preference, hazard, value-of-time and physical corrections are prototype scenarios, not estimates from SNU observations.
forecast_seat_interpretation: One indivisible marginal person is queried AFTER the ordinary weighted FIFO forecast of people ahead. No rounding of pre-queue seats; no accumulation of fractions across departures. Physical weighted demand, capacity and actual boarding unchanged. Not a probability guarantee.
wait_discomfort_interpretation: Prospective increment G(A+W)-G(A) of cumulative journey waiting. Completed wait A affects marginal discomfort, never physical ETA. Same polynomial scales as V12; uncalibrated alternative hypothesis. No reset by walking to another queue.
random_utility_interpretation: One trip-strategy residual per agent, reused at every reconsideration. Full temporal persistence is an unestimated sensitivity boundary, not an empirical estimate.
